sharedRules.name: And they shall know no Fear
sharedRules.description:
Space Marine units with this rule gain the following benefits:
• Space Marine units automatically Rally at the start of your movement phase.
• Space Marine units do not take any wounds when retreating from a model that performed a sweeping advance ending their sweeping advance within 1” of the Space Marine model.
• If a Space Marine would undertake a Fall Back Move after failing a Panic test which would cause it to move off the board, it stops 1” away from the board edge and instead automatically rallies.

sharedRules.name: Shield of Faith
sharedRules.description: All Adeptus Sororitas units have a 6+ invulnerable save and the Adamantium will special rule.

sharedRules.name: Iron Halo
sharedRules.description: A model with an Iron Halo has a 4+ Invulnerable save.

sharedRules.name: Grav-Chute
sharedRules.description: A model with a Grav-Chute gains the Deep Strike Special rule.

sharedRules.name: Null Rod
sharedRules.description: A model with this Wargear cannot be affected by Psychic Powers or targeted by Psychic Weapons. In addition, a model with this special rule gains the Bane (Psykers) on all Melee weapons it is equipped with.

sharedRules.name: Auspex Scanner
sharedRules.description: Enemy units may not Infiltrate within 18” of a model equipped with this wargear.

sharedRules.name: Digital Weapons
sharedRules.description: A model with Digital weapons gains +1 to their Attacks (A) characteristic.

sharedRules.name: Med Kit
sharedRules.description: A model with this Wargear and their attached unit gain Feel No Pain (5+) Special rule.

sharedRules.name: Paragon War Suit
sharedRules.description: These ancient mechanical walker suits provide a high degree of protection to their pilot through various armour panels over the pilots standard Power armour and strong energy shields. It confers a 2+ Armour save and a 4+ Invulnerable save. The equipped model gains +1 Strength (S) and +2 to its Toughness (T) characteristic. The equipped model gains the Firing Protocols (2) and Relentless special rule.

sharedRules.name: Penance Engine
sharedRules.description: This mechanical engine is a solid piece of war machine that is capable of withstanding incoming fire as it charges blindly towards foes. It confers a 4+ Armour save.

sharedRules.name: Carapace Armour
sharedRules.description: Heavy Combat Armour. It confers a 4+ Armour save.

sharedRules.name: Flak Armour
sharedRules.description: Basic Combat armour. It provides a 5+ Armour Save.

sharedRules.name: Angels of Death
sharedRules.comment: todo: No profile provided in reference

sharedRules.name: Reliable Machine Spirit
sharedRules.description: When a unit with this special rule would be destroyed. Embarked units are not required to roll for models inside being slain (see Rule 10.2 in the core rules).

sharedRules.name: Machine Spirit
sharedRules.description: This unit may always set to Overwatch, even if it made a shooting attack in the Shooting phase.

sharedRules.name: Decree Passive
sharedRules.description: You may only include 1 unit with the Cult Ministorum keyword for every 3 Adeptus Sororitas units in your army. Units with this special rule may not be your warlord unless there are no Adeptus Sororitas units in your army.

sharedRules.name: Loud Hailers
sharedRules.description: When a model with this wargear has the Fear (1) special rule.

sharedRules.name: Void Shields (x)
sharedRules.description: A unit with this wargear gains a number of Void Shield Tokens equal to the value of (x). Each time this unit takes a Penetrating Hit, if it has a Void Shield Token, you spend a token to ignore that Penetrating Hit. At the start of each Battle Round, you regain 1 spent Void Shield Token. Instead of setting to Overwatch, you can set to Recharge Voids. A unit that Recharges Voids, regains all of its Void Shield Tokens.

rules.name: Master of Command
rules.description: You may only field 1 model in your army with this special rule. If your army includes a model with this special rule, they must be your Warlord.

rules.name: Rosarius
rules.description: A model with a Rosarius has a 4+ Invulnerable save.

rules.name: Storm Shields
rules.description: Storm Shields provide the model equipped with the Storm Shield a 4+ Invulnerable save. A model with this wargear gains the Battle-Hardened special rule.

rules.name: Bionics
rules.description: A model with this wargear gains the Feel no Pain (6+) special rule.

rules.name: Combat Shields
rules.description: A model equipped with this wargear has a 6+ Invulnerable save. In addition, they gain +1 to their Armour Save Max 2+) in the Combat Phase.

rules.name: Melta Bomb
rules.description: In combat, a model with this wargear may forgo its attacks and instead make a single Strength 8, AP1 attack with the Melta Special rule at Initiative step 1.

rules.name: Psychic Hood
rules.description: A unit that arrives on the battlefield via Deep Strike within 12” of a unit with this wargear does not scatter.

rules.name: Chapter Banner
rules.description: Friendly Space Marines units within 12” of the Banner can re-roll Pinning and Panic tests. In addition, when calculating the number of wounds caused in a combat for the purpose of determining if a unit within 12” of a model with this wargear has won or lost a combat, add 1 to the number of wounds caused by friendly Space Marine units within 12” of a model with this wargear.

rules.name: Refractor field
rules.description: A model with a refractor Field has a 5+ Invulnerable save.

rules.name: Teleport Homer
rules.description: A unit that arrives on the battlefield via Deep Strike within 12” of a unit with this wargear does not scatter.

rules.name: Narthecium
rules.description: A model with this Wargear and their attached unit gain Feel No Pain (5+) Special rule.

rules.name: Vox Caster
rules.description: A unit with this Wargear automatically Rallies at the start of its Movement phase. In addition, the unit may receive an Order from any unit with the Character special rule that is also equipped with, or its attached unit is also equipped with a Vox Caster.

rules.name: Power Armour
rules.description: Basic Power Armour used by most Astartes. It provides a 3+ Armour Save.

rules.name: Artificer Armour
rules.description: Master work Armour issued to veterans and champions. It provides a 2+ Armour Save.

rules.name: Indomitus Terminator Armour
rules.description: The Standard Terminator Armour used by most Astartes forces. It provides a 2+ Armour Save and a 5+ Invulnerable Save. The wearer gains the Relentless, Bulky (2) and Deep Strike special rule. Models equipped with this Armour may not perform Sweeping Advances. It grants the Terminator Keyword.

rules.name: Dreadnought Plate
rules.description: These ancient and powerful mechanised war suit encompasses a sarcophagus where an ancient warrior lay entombed. When combined, the warrior may take to the field again with a new body. It confers a 2+ Armour save.

rules.name: Gravis Armour
rules.description: Gravis Armour is a bulk multi-layered heavy assault Armour for Primaris. It provides a 3+ Armour save and grants the wearer +1 to their Toughness (T) characteristic. The wearers Movement (M) Characteristic is decreased by 1”. The model gains the Bulky (2) special rule. If a model wearing Gravis Armour is hit by a weapon with the Blast or Large Blast special rule, decrease the AP of the weapon by 1 (e.g 3 becomes 4) for the purposes of resolving that hit. The model gains the Relentless Special rule.

rules.name: Phobos Armour
rules.description: A Stealth designed version of the standard power Armour for infiltration. It provides a 3+ Armour save and grants the wearer the Infiltrate special rule.

rules.name: Jump Pack
rules.description: A unit that is equipped with a Jump Pack increases its Movement (M) characteristic to 12”. The model gains the Hammer of Wrath (1), Bulky (2), Fly and Deep Strike special rules.

rules.name: Mount
rules.description: A unit that is equipped with a Mount becomes the Cavalry type. In addition, the model gains +1 to its Wounds (W) characteristic. A mount is equipped with close combat weapons.

rules.name: Smoke Launchers
rules.description: A model equipped with this Wargear can set to smoke instead of Overwatching. Until the start of its next turn, the model gains a 4+ Cover Save.

rules.name: Searchlight
rules.description: A model with this special rule gains the Night Vision special rule. Any unit that it targets in the Shooting Phase no longer gains the benefit of Night Fighting. Any attacks against this unit are not affected by Night Fighting.

rules.name: Assault launchers
rules.description: A model equipped with this Wargear can make 1 additional Hammer of Wrath Attack.

rules.name: Rite of Immolation (Machine Rite)
rules.description: When this Rite is performed successfully, select 1 friendly Walker, Automata, Vehicle, Knight, Fortification or Aircraft unit within 6” of the unit performing this Rite or the unit performing the Rite is embarked upon. That unit immediately suffers an Explodes result per the Vehicle Damage Chart, even if it would normally not.

rules.name: Rite of Repair (Machine Rite)
rules.description:
When this Rite is performed successfully, select one of the following effects:
• Select 1 Walker or Automata unit either within 3” or attached to the unit that is performing this rite. The target unit Heals 1 wound.
• Select 1 Vehicle, Aircraft, Knight or Fortification either within 3”, attached to the unit performing this Rite or that this unit is embarked upon. Select 1 weapon that target unit is equipped with that has been destroyed. The chosen weapon is no longer destroyed.
• Select 1 Vehicle or Knight either within 3”, attached to the unit performing this Rite or that this unit is embarked upon that is immobilized. That unit is no longer immobilized. If the unit has the Super Heavy (x) special rule and was Limping, it is no longer considered to be Limping.

rules.name: Litany of Foxus (Prayer)
rules.description: When this Prayer is performed, the Priest and any attached unit has the Indomitable Spirit (4+) special rule until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

rules.name: Litany of Hatred (Prayer)
rules.description: When this Prayer is performed, the Priest and any attached unit gain the Hatred special rule until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

rules.name: Litany of Rage (Prayer)
rules.description: When this Prayer is performed, the Priest and any attached unit gain the Fear (1) special rule until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

rules.name: Litany of Strength (Prayer)
rules.description: When this Prayer is performed, the Priest and any attached unit gain +1 to their Strength (S) characteristic until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

rules.name: Rite of Consecration (Machine Rite)
rules.description: When this Rite is performed successfully, select 1 friendly Walker, Automata, Vehicle, Knight, Fortification or Aircraft unit within 6” of the unit performing this Rite or the unit performing the Rite is embarked upon. That unit gains the Indomitable Spirit (6+) special rule until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

rules.name: Rite of Reloading (Machine Rite)
rules.description: When this Rite is performed successfully, select 1 friendly Walker, Automata, Vehicle, Knight, Fortification or Aircraft unit within 6” of the unit performing this Rite or the unit performing the Rite is embarked upon. That unit immediately makes a Shooting Attack with 1 weapon it is equipped with.

rules.name: Bike
rules.description: A unit that is equipped with a Bike becomes a Bike type unit. In addition, it gains +1 Toughness (T) Characteristics. A Space marine Bike is equipped with a Linked Boltgun.

rules.name: Cataphractii Terminator Armour
rules.description: An ancient heavier pattern of Terminator Armour rarely used. It provides a 2+ Armour save and a 4+ Invulnerable save. The Wearer gains the Relentless, Bulky (2) and Slow & Purposeful special rules. The wearers Movement (M) Characteristic is decreased by 1”. It grants the Terminator Keyword.

rules.name: Tartaros Terminator Armour
rules.description: A more mobile ancient pattern of Terminator Armour rarely used. It provides a 2+ Armour Save and a 5+ Invulnerable save. The Wearer gains Relentless, Bulky (2), and Sprint (1) special rules. It grants the Terminator Keyword.

rules.name: Relic Shield
rules.description: A Model with a Relic Shield has a 4+ Invulnerable save and gains the Adamantium Will and Indomitable Will (3+) special rule.

rules.name: Flagellant Protocols
rules.description: Arco Flagellant models in this unit gain the benefit of the Frenzy, Rage and Feel no Pain (5+) special rules. However, Arco Flagellant models in this unit never benefit from the effects of Prayers.

rules.name: Storm Shield
rules.description: A model equipped with this wargear has a 4+ Invulnerable Save. A model equipped with this wargear gains the Battle-Hardened special rule

rules.name: Assassin Suit
rules.description: A skintight and flexible suit used by assassins that allows unparalleled movement. It confers a 6+ Armour save and a 5+ Invulnerable save.

rules.name: Transport
rules.description: This model can transport 10 Infantry models. It may also Transport 1 Dreadnought model.

rules.name: Infernum Halo Launcher
rules.description: Instead of setting to Overwatch, this unit may set to Deploy Chaff. When this unit deploys Chaff, all attacks against this unit have -1 to all hit rolls until the start of this units next Shooing Phase.

rules.name: Suicide Unit
rules.description: All attacks from this unit in the Combat Phase, automatically hit. After a model with this special rule has made all of its attacks in the Combat Phase, it is removed from play. When this unit would be slain and removed in play in the Shooting Phase or Charge Phase, all units within 6” of this model are hit with 6 automatic hits resolved using the Cyclops demolitions weapon.

rules.name: Tracked Automata
rules.description: This model increases its Movement (M) Characteristic to 12”. In addition, this unit automatically passes all Pinning and Panic tests.

rules.name: Self-Driving Targeting
rules.description: After deployment, each model in this unit is treated as its own separate unit. A unit with this special rule may never contest or hold an objective. This unit does not count for scoring objectives when it is slain and removed from play.

rules.name: Compact
rules.description: This unit can be Transported by a Valkyrie Dropship. For the purposes of being transported and embarked, it has the Bulky (2) special rule.
